latest.headline: Probe build to verify the in-app update notice.

releases.headline: Probe build to verify the in-app update notice.

changes.text: In-app update notice: you are told when a newer build exists
What's new ends at the newest release, even on an older APK
Probe row — this feed is reverted right after the screenshot

releases.headline: Smoother everywhere, and SUB/DUB that finally switches what you are watching.

changes.text: Screen changes glide instead of sliding: a little spring, a little depth
The video opens on a title page with a smooth grow instead of the page jumping down
Episode rows move into place instead of snapping when progress and new episodes arrive
SUB/DUB is shown on every episode row, accented on the track that row will really play
With a video already playing on the title page, tapping SUB or DUB only moved the chip; it now switches the audio and keeps your place
DUB really plays the English track: the first server ignored the choice and always opened the original audio
The buttons only appear for audio the episode actually has, and they follow the player instead of drifting from it
Changing episode no longer carries a language the new episode does not have, which could start it in the wrong audio or not at all

releases.headline: Every genre on a title page is now a shortcut, and a sleep timer that puts the phone to sleep.

changes.text: Tap a genre on any title page to see everything else in it, already filtered
Back from a genre returns to the title you came from, not to the top of the app
The sleep timer runs on the clock: pausing the video no longer pauses the countdown
When the timer runs out the episode is stopped, not paused, and the phone is left free to go to sleep
The sleep timer keeps running through a rotation or a trip to picture-in-picture; it used to vanish while the episode kept playing
The sleep menu shows the real time left instead of the time you picked
Tapping the same length again restarts the countdown instead of doing nothing
Stop at end of episode no longer stays armed after the episode has finished

releases.headline: A polish pass: downloads that tell the truth, a player that stays put, a schedule that keeps up.

changes.text: Downloads save their progress far less often, so they are lighter on the battery
Settings no longer shows a bottom bar with nothing selected, and Support has its own icon
A download whose file was deleted from the phone now says so and offers retry, instead of doing nothing
A phone that is out of space no longer makes the app try the same episode on every server in turn
Long episodes no longer stop halfway through and start over
An episode no longer looks finished when half of it was never downloaded
Downloaded subtitles keep their own file type, so they open in other players too
Screen brightness stays where you set it after locking the player
Playback speed stays put when you change episode
Subtitles keep time with the picture instead of stuttering the video
An episode turns to Out the moment it airs, and the schedule follows midnight and your phone's 12/24-hour setting
A quick double tap on the heart no longer loses a favourite
Back closes the player on the first press, and a stray second tap no longer closes the app
Support page links to the new Telegram channel, @dr_animo_apk

releases.headline: Download and watch offline, a weekly airing schedule, favourites and your own colours.

changes.text: Download episodes and watch them offline: pick languages, subtitles and any quality the servers have
Download SUB and DUB (or Hindi) of the same episode in one go
Downloads page with progress, speed and time left; open any finished episode in VLC or another player
Change a download's server, and a failed server hands over to the next one by itself
Episodes play right on the title page; go full screen when you want, or turn on auto full screen in Settings
Schedule tab: what airs each day this week, in your time zone, with Airing today on Home
Favourites: tap the heart on any title, find them in their own tab and on Home
New episodes of airing shows and favourites are picked up quietly in the background
Six accent colours and a pure black mode for OLED screens
More servers and languages, including Hindi, with skip intro, up next and screen lock in the player
Support Animo page in the drawer: Telegram channel and crypto tips
Smoother screen changes, tab and drawer animations
Play and skip buttons sit in the exact middle of the player, and subtitles stay clear of the controls
Settings moved to the drawer to make room for Schedule and Favourites
